body: Do you really have a different result with Vim? I used latest master and the version you specified and got the same result (`/path/test/subdir       /path/test`) with `nvim -u NORC -S test.vim` and `vim -u NORC -S test.vim` on macOS.
Sorry, my bad. I tested and thought I observed a different behaviour, but you are right: Vim and neovim behaves the same.

Thansk for attacking this!
Does the assertion from https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/7662 fail here?

body: If you mean `t-pwd-with-autocmd.vim`, then no. But it doesn't seem to fail with master either.
Please check if the latest master works as expected for you!

(Yeah, the test from #7662 does not work anymore, since the changing of the window in the FileType autocommand is not allowed anymore)

Thanks for the fix, but it seems to be related to autochdir only (which I am not using).
@blueyed does that mean https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/9042 can be closed?

@justinmk 
Well, since I am not using autochdir I think this fix here does not help me, but I've not noticed a problem with it for a while (but was not paying too much attention I guess).  Since #9042 does not really help in its current state I've closed it.
It seems the recent commit fixes the issue. Thanks! Looking forward to seeing 0.4.0 being released. Thank you for all the great work on maintaining and developing neovim!

> Looking forward to seeing 0.4.0 being released

0.4.0 might take some time, but this fix will be in the next 0.3.x release. f891131c6bb2

issue.title: vim-patch:8.2.{3468,3617,3618,3622}: some other CWD related patches

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
#### vim-patch:8.2.3468: problem with :cd when editing file in non-existent directory

Problem:    Problem with :cd when editing file in non-existent directory. (Yee
            Cheng Chin)
Solution:   Prepend the current directory to get the full path.
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/c6376c798433bcb9ee38a8664299d11454546950


#### vim-patch:8.2.3617: ":verbose pwd" does not mention 'autochdir' was applied

Problem:    ":verbose pwd" does not mention 'autochdir' was applied.
Solution:   Remember the last chdir was done by 'autochdir'.  (issue vim/vim#9142)
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/0526815c15170a5926e1008600ec29d42d8b64c2


#### vim-patch:8.2.3618: getcwd() is unclear about how 'autochdir' is used

Problem:    getcwd() is unclear about how 'autochdir' is used.
Solution:   Update the help for getcwd().  Without any arguments always return
            the actual current directory.
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/851c7a699ae00bdc14a4db874cf722b7b7393b53

#### vim-patch:8.2.3622: "verbose pwd" shows confusing info

Problem:    "verbose pwd" shows confusing info when :lcd does not change
            directory.
Solution:   Clear last_chdir_reason also when the directory does not change.
            (closes vim/vim#9160)
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/64be6aa3a54ecfe355d4a03e1200650c301e7f29
